items.title: Cambridge Audio Melomania A100 SE Adds Dolby Audio to Affordable TWS Earbuds
items.summary: Cambridge Audio launched the Melomania A100 SE true wireless earbuds at 149 euros, adding Dolby Audio spatial sound to the existing A100 platform. The earbuds keep Class A/B amplification, 10mm drivers, aptX Lossless and LDAC, adaptive hybrid ANC, and up to 39 hours of battery life.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds On Debut With Clip-On Open-Ear Design and 9.5-Hour Battery
items.summary: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on open-ear wireless earbuds that keep the ear canal open for situational awareness. Powered by the Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 platform with TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction and Gemini Live, they offer up to 9.5 hours of playback and launch in South Korea on October 27.

items.title: Bose Doubles Down on Open-Ear With $199 Sport Open and $299 Ultra Open 2nd Gen
items.summary: Bose expanded its open-ear range from one flagship to two models shipping October 1. The $299 Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen add a redesigned driver, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial head tracking and aptX Adaptive, while the $199 Sport Open targets runners with a C-arm cuff, IP54 rating and 22-hour case battery.

items.title: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r Jade Mist Launches in India at 1,599 Rupees Festive Price
items.summary: OnePlus added a Jade Mist color option to its Nord Buds 3r TWS earbuds ahead of the Indian festive season. The earbuds offer 12.4mm titanium-coated drivers, up to 54 hours of battery, AI call noise cancellation, 47ms low-latency gaming mode and Bluetooth 5.4, available from October 8 at an effective 1,599 rupees.

items.title: Noise Opens Pre-Booking for Master Buds Open Clip-On Earbuds With Bose Tuning
items.summary: Indian brand Noise began pre-booking its first open-ear earbuds, the Master Buds Open, at 999 rupees ahead of an October 23 launch priced at 7,999 rupees. The C-bridge clip-on TWS features Sound by Bose tuning, a 10.8mm driver, 4-mic ENC, 360-degree spatial audio and up to 28 hours of playback.

items.title: Timekettle Launches $129 LiveTalk Open-Ear AI Interpreter Earbuds
items.summary: Timekettle announced the LiveTalk open-ear AI interpreter earbuds at $129, combining real-time translation across 54 languages and 108 accents with everyday audio. The 6.9g ear-hook earbuds support four translation modes, offline language pairs, dual-device connection and up to 35 hours of total battery life.

items.title: AVIOT Opens Pre-Orders for 96Neko Collaboration True Wireless Earbuds
items.summary: AVIOT opened pre-orders for the TE-V1R-96N, a special-edition true wireless earbuds created with utaite 96Neko. Based on the TE-V1R with 19 hours of playback, adaptive hybrid ANC, LDAC and wireless charging, it ships from late October with custom voice lines and collector artwork.

items.title: Omdia: Global TWS Shipments Fall 0.7% in Q2 2026 as Open-Ear Grows 12%
items.summary: Omdia reported global true wireless stereo shipments of 82.1 million units in Q2 2026, down 0.7% year-on-year for the first decline since 2023, with China falling 9.5%. Open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million units, a 13.5% share, while clip-on designs led with 61% of OWS shipments.

items.title: Best True Wireless Earbuds 2026: Sony, Apple, Bose and Sennheiser Lead Buyer Guides
items.summary: Current buying guides split 2026 true wireless recommendations by ecosystem: Sony WF-1000XM6 for all-around use, Apple AirPods Pro 3 for iPhone with heart-rate sensing, Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2nd Gen for noise cancelling, and Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 for Android with aptX Lossless.

items.title: Anker Soundcore Unveils THUS AI-Chip Earbuds and Headphones at IFA 2026
items.summary: Anker showcased a broad Soundcore audio lineup at IFA 2026 built around its new THUS AI chip for on-device intelligence across earbuds and headphones. The range emphasizes adaptive audio, translation and health-adjacent features as Anker pushes AI from a marketing tagline into the product stack.
